title: BaseSettings moved to pydantic-settings
description: `from pydantic import BaseSettings` raises `PydanticImportError` in v2. Settings management now lives in the `pydantic-settings` package. `class Config: env_prefix = "X_"` becomes `model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_prefix="X_")`. Add `pydantic-settings` to your dependencies.

title: @validator / @root_validator renamed
description: `@validator("field")` must be replaced with `@field_validator("field")` (import `field_validator`); validators must be classmethods. `@root_validator` must be replaced with `@model_validator(mode="before")` or `@model_validator(mode="after")`. The bare v1 form `@root_validator` (post validation, no arguments) raises an error at class-definition time in v2. `mode="after"` validators receive and return the model instance (`self`), not a `values` dict.

title: class Config removed — use model_config / ConfigDict
description: The inner `class Config` is replaced by a `model_config = ConfigDict(...)` class attribute (import `ConfigDict` from `pydantic`). Renamed options: `allow_mutation = False` → `frozen = True`; `orm_mode = True` → `from_attributes = True`; `allow_population_by_field_name` → `populate_by_name`; `max_anystr_length` → `str_max_length`. Using removed options such as `allow_mutation` raises an error in v2.

title: Field keyword renames (regex, min_items, max_items, const)
description: Removed `Field` keyword arguments raise `PydanticUserError` at class-definition time in v2. Replacements: `regex=` → `pattern=`; `min_items=` → `min_length=`; `max_items=` → `max_length=`; `const=...` → use `Literal[...]` type; `unique_items` is removed (use validators or `Set` types).

title: Renamed model methods (.dict, .json, .copy, .schema, .parse_obj, .parse_raw)
description: The v1 methods still exist in v2 but emit `PydanticDeprecatedSince20` warnings and will be removed. Migrate to the new names: `Model.parse_obj(d)` → `Model.model_validate(d)`; `Model.parse_raw(s)` → `Model.model_validate_json(s)`; `m.dict()` → `m.model_dump()`; `m.json()` → `m.model_dump_json()`; `m.copy(update=...)` → `m.model_copy(update=...)`; `Model.schema()` → `Model.model_json_schema()`; `Model.construct()` → `Model.model_construct()`; `m.__fields__` → `Model.model_fields`.
old_pattern: m.dict() / m.json() / m.copy() / Model.schema() / Model.parse_obj() / Model.parse_raw() / Model.construct() / m.__fields__
new_pattern: m.model_dump() / m.model_dump_json() / m.model_copy() / Model.model_json_schema() / Model.model_validate() / Model.model_validate_json() / Model.model_construct() / Model.model_fields

title: Behavioral changes: frozen raises ValidationError, Optional without default is required
description: v2 is stricter about type coercion; `Optional[X]` fields without a default are required in v2 (in v1 they implicitly defaulted to `None`). Mutating a field on a `frozen=True` model raises `pydantic.ValidationError` in v2, whereas v1 `allow_mutation=False` raised `TypeError`. `.json()`/`model_dump_json()` output may differ in whitespace and datetime formatting. Error messages and `ValidationError` structures changed; tests that assert exact error text may need updating.
old_pattern: with pytest.raises(TypeError):  # mutation on allow_mutation=False model
new_pattern: with pytest.raises(ValidationError):  # mutation on frozen=True model
